definition: suffering from an illness
exampleSentence: My mother is very sick.
exampleTranslation: Mẹ tôi đang ốm nặng.

definition: not feeling well because of a disease
exampleSentence: I can't come to work because I'm ill.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không đi làm được vì tôi bị ốm.

definition: strong and not likely to become ill
exampleSentence: Eating fruit keeps you healthy.
exampleTranslation: Ăn trái cây giúp bạn khỏe mạnh.

definition: in good health
exampleSentence: I don't feel very well today.
exampleTranslation: Hôm nay tôi thấy không khỏe lắm.

definition: less ill or painful than before
exampleSentence: I feel much better today.
exampleTranslation: Hôm nay tôi thấy đỡ hơn nhiều.

definition: more ill than before
exampleSentence: My cough is worse tonight.
exampleTranslation: Tối nay cơn ho của tôi nặng hơn.

definition: to become well again after being ill
exampleSentence: I hope you get better soon.
exampleTranslation: Mong bạn mau khỏe lại.

definition: to get well again after an illness or accident
exampleSentence: Tom is slowly recovering from the flu.
exampleTranslation: Tom đang dần hồi phục sau cơn cảm cúm.

definition: the condition of your body and how healthy you are
exampleSentence: Your health is more important than money.
exampleTranslation: Sức khỏe của bạn quan trọng hơn tiền bạc.

definition: a disease of the body or mind
exampleSentence: Tom missed school because of a long illness.
exampleTranslation: Tom nghỉ học vì bị ốm lâu ngày.

definition: an illness that affects people, animals or plants
exampleSentence: Washing your hands can stop many diseases.
exampleTranslation: Rửa tay có thể ngăn nhiều loại bệnh.

definition: a sign in your body that shows you have an illness
exampleSentence: A cough is a common symptom of a cold.
exampleTranslation: Ho là một triệu chứng thường gặp của bệnh cảm lạnh.

definition: a common illness that gives you a runny nose and sore throat
exampleSentence: I have a bad cold.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị cảm nặng.

definition: an illness that makes you feel tired and weak and gives you a cough
exampleSentence: Half of my class has the flu.
exampleTranslation: Một nửa lớp tôi bị cúm.

definition: an illness in which your body temperature is very high
exampleSentence: The child has a fever.
exampleTranslation: Đứa bé đang bị sốt.

definition: an illness or a habit of coughing a lot
exampleSentence: I have a bad cough.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị ho nặng.

definition: a throat that is painful, often because of a cold
exampleSentence: I have a sore throat.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị đau họng.

definition: a pain in your head
exampleSentence: I have a headache.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị đau đầu.

definition: a pain in a tooth
exampleSentence: Toothache kept me awake all night.
exampleTranslation: Cơn đau răng làm tôi thức cả đêm.

definition: a pain in your stomach
exampleSentence: I have a stomachache after lunch.
exampleTranslation: Sau bữa trưa tôi bị đau bụng.

definition: a pain inside your ear
exampleSentence: My son has an earache.
exampleTranslation: Con tôi bị đau tai.

definition: a pain in your back
exampleSentence: Sitting all day gives me backache.
exampleTranslation: Ngồi cả ngày làm tôi đau lưng.

definition: the feeling you have when part of your body hurts
exampleSentence: I have a sharp pain in my knee.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị đau nhói ở đầu gối.

definition: a continuous pain that is not sharp
exampleSentence: I have an ache in my back.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị đau âm ỉ ở lưng.

definition: painful, especially because of an infection or too much use
exampleSentence: My legs are sore after the long walk.
exampleTranslation: Chân tôi đau nhức sau chuyến đi bộ dài.

definition: to feel pain in a part of your body
exampleSentence: My back hurts.
exampleTranslation: Lưng tôi đau.

definition: to hurt a joint by twisting it suddenly
exampleSentence: I fell and sprained my ankle.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị ngã và bong gân mắt cá chân.

definition: a wound made when something sharp cuts your skin
exampleSentence: I have a small cut on my finger.
exampleTranslation: Tôi có một vết cắt nhỏ trên ngón tay.

definition: an injury caused by fire, heat or the sun
exampleSentence: I have a burn on my hand.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị bỏng ở tay.

definition: a dark mark on your skin where you have been hit
exampleSentence: I have a bruise on my leg.
exampleTranslation: Chân tôi có một vết bầm.

definition: an injury to your body, such as a cut
exampleSentence: The nurse cleaned the wound.
exampleTranslation: Y tá làm sạch vết thương.

definition: damage to part of your body caused by an accident
exampleSentence: Tom has a leg injury.
exampleTranslation: Tom bị chấn thương ở chân.

definition: having a wound or damage to part of your body
exampleSentence: Three people were injured in the accident.
exampleTranslation: Ba người bị thương trong vụ tai nạn.

definition: cracked or in pieces after an accident
exampleSentence: I have a broken leg.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị gãy chân.

definition: bigger than normal because of illness or injury
exampleSentence: My ankle is swollen.
exampleTranslation: Mắt cá chân của tôi bị sưng.

definition: a lot of red spots on your skin
exampleSentence: There is a red rash on my arm.
exampleTranslation: Trên tay tôi có một vùng phát ban đỏ.

definition: to have an unpleasant feeling on your skin that makes you want to scratch
exampleSentence: My arm itches.
exampleTranslation: Tay tôi bị ngứa.

definition: to lose blood from your body
exampleSentence: My nose is bleeding.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị chảy máu mũi.

definition: feeling unable to stand steadily
exampleSentence: I feel dizzy when I stand up.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thấy chóng mặt khi đứng dậy.

definition: feeling that you want to sleep or rest
exampleSentence: I am too tired to go out.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mệt quá nên không đi chơi được.

definition: to suddenly become unconscious for a short time
exampleSentence: Someone fainted in the hot room.
exampleTranslation: Có người ngất xỉu trong căn phòng nóng.

definition: to suddenly blow air out through your nose and mouth
exampleSentence: I sneeze a lot in spring.
exampleTranslation: Tôi hắt hơi nhiều vào mùa xuân.

definition: to bring food up from your stomach through your mouth
exampleSentence: The child vomited after dinner.
exampleTranslation: Đứa bé nôn sau bữa tối.

definition: an illness in which you often pass watery waste from your body
exampleSentence: Bad water can cause diarrhoea.
exampleTranslation: Nước bẩn có thể gây tiêu chảy.

definition: a condition in which a substance makes you ill or gives you a rash
exampleSentence: I have an allergy to peanuts.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị dị ứng đậu phộng.

definition: an illness caused by bacteria or a virus
exampleSentence: I have an ear infection.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị nhiễm trùng tai.

definition: a very small living thing that causes illness
exampleSentence: Many children caught the virus.
exampleTranslation: Nhiều trẻ em bị nhiễm vi-rút.

definition: a very small living thing that can make you ill
exampleSentence: Wash your hands to kill germs.
exampleTranslation: Hãy rửa tay để diệt vi trùng.

definition: continuous worry that stops you from relaxing
exampleSentence: Stress can give you headaches.
exampleTranslation: Căng thẳng có thể làm bạn đau đầu.

definition: a time when you relax or sleep and do nothing tiring
exampleSentence: You look tired. Take a rest.
exampleTranslation: Trông bạn mệt đấy. Nghỉ ngơi chút đi.

definition: to rest your mind and body, usually at night
exampleSentence: I sleep eight hours every night.
exampleTranslation: Đêm nào tôi cũng ngủ tám tiếng.

definition: a person who is getting medical treatment
exampleSentence: The doctor is with a patient.
exampleTranslation: Bác sĩ đang khám cho một bệnh nhân.

definition: a place where people get medical treatment without staying overnight
exampleSentence: The clinic opens at eight.
exampleTranslation: Phòng khám mở cửa lúc tám giờ.

definition: a large room in a hospital where patients stay
exampleSentence: The nurse walked through the ward.
exampleTranslation: Y tá đi qua phòng bệnh.

definition: a room where people wait to see a doctor
exampleSentence: Please sit in the waiting room.
exampleTranslation: Mời bạn ngồi ở phòng chờ.

definition: a shop where you can buy medicines
exampleSentence: I bought some tablets at the chemist.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mua vài viên thuốc ở hiệu thuốc.

definition: a dangerous situation that needs action immediately
translation: tình huống khẩn cấp, cấp cứu
exampleSentence: Call this number in an emergency.
exampleTranslation: Hãy gọi số này khi có trường hợp khẩn cấp.

definition: an event in which someone is hurt or something is damaged
exampleSentence: I had an accident at work.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị tai nạn ở chỗ làm.

definition: simple medical help given quickly to a hurt person
translation: sơ cứu, cấp cứu ban đầu
exampleSentence: I learned first aid at school.
exampleTranslation: Tôi học sơ cứu ở trường.

definition: connected with medicine and the treatment of illness
exampleSentence: You need medical help.
exampleTranslation: Bạn cần được trợ giúp y tế.

definition: a medical examination to make sure you are healthy
translation: khám sức khỏe, kiểm tra sức khỏe
exampleSentence: I have a check-up every year.
exampleTranslation: Mỗi năm tôi đi khám sức khỏe một lần.

definition: a substance you take to treat an illness
exampleSentence: Take this medicine twice a day.
exampleTranslation: Hãy uống thuốc này hai lần một ngày.

definition: a small solid piece of medicine that you swallow
exampleSentence: I take a pill every morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nào tôi cũng uống một viên thuốc.

definition: a medicine that reduces pain
exampleSentence: I took a painkiller for my headache.
exampleTranslation: Tôi uống thuốc giảm đau vì bị đau đầu.

definition: drugs that kill bacteria and cure infections
exampleSentence: The doctor gave me antibiotics.
exampleTranslation: Bác sĩ cho tôi thuốc kháng sinh.

definition: a soft cream you put on your skin to treat it
exampleSentence: Put this ointment on the rash.
exampleTranslation: Hãy bôi thuốc mỡ này lên chỗ phát ban.

definition: a paper on which a doctor writes what medicine you need
exampleSentence: You need a prescription for this medicine.
exampleTranslation: Bạn cần có đơn thuốc để mua loại thuốc này.

definition: an act of putting medicine into your body with a needle
exampleSentence: The nurse gave me an injection.
exampleTranslation: Y tá tiêm cho tôi một mũi.

definition: a substance that protects you from a disease
exampleSentence: Children get a vaccine against measles.
exampleTranslation: Trẻ em được tiêm vắc-xin phòng bệnh sởi.

definition: a long piece of cloth you tie around an injury
exampleSentence: The nurse put a bandage on my arm.
exampleTranslation: Y tá quấn băng lên tay tôi.

definition: a small piece of material you stick on your skin to cover a cut
translation: băng cá nhân, miếng dán vết thương
exampleSentence: I put a plaster on my finger.
exampleTranslation: Tôi dán băng cá nhân lên ngón tay.

definition: a liquid that kills germs
translation: thuốc sát trùng, chất khử trùng
exampleSentence: Use disinfectant to clean the cut.
exampleTranslation: Hãy dùng thuốc sát trùng để rửa vết cắt.

definition: a tool that measures how hot your body is
exampleSentence: Put the thermometer under your tongue.
exampleTranslation: Hãy đặt nhiệt kế dưới lưỡi.

definition: the force with which blood moves around your body
exampleSentence: The nurse checked my blood pressure.
exampleTranslation: Y tá đo huyết áp cho tôi.

definition: a photograph of the inside of your body
exampleSentence: The doctor took an X-ray of my arm.
exampleTranslation: Bác sĩ chụp X-quang cánh tay cho tôi.

definition: medical treatment in which a doctor cuts into your body
exampleSentence: I need an operation on my knee.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cần phẫu thuật đầu gối.

definition: medical treatment in which a doctor cuts into your body
exampleSentence: Tom had surgery on his leg.
exampleTranslation: Tom đã phải phẫu thuật chân.

definition: to try to make an ill person well again
exampleSentence: Doctors treat sick people.
exampleTranslation: Bác sĩ chữa trị cho người bệnh.

definition: to make an illness go away
exampleSentence: Doctors can cure many diseases.
exampleTranslation: Bác sĩ có thể chữa khỏi nhiều bệnh.

definition: if a wound or injury heals, it becomes healthy again
exampleSentence: My arm healed in six weeks.
exampleTranslation: Tay tôi lành sau sáu tuần.

definition: a chair with wheels for people who cannot walk
exampleSentence: My grandmother uses a wheelchair.
exampleTranslation: Bà tôi dùng xe lăn.

definition: two long sticks that help you walk when your leg is hurt
exampleSentence: Tom walked with crutches for a month.
exampleTranslation: Tom chống nạng đi suốt một tháng.

definition: not able to hear, or not able to hear well
exampleSentence: My grandfather is deaf in one ear.
exampleTranslation: Ông tôi bị điếc một bên tai.

definition: not able to use a part of your body fully
exampleSentence: The building has a ramp for disabled people.
exampleTranslation: Tòa nhà có lối đi cho người khuyết tật.

definition: time you are allowed to stay away from work when ill
exampleSentence: I am on sick leave this week.
exampleTranslation: Tuần này tôi nghỉ ốm.

definition: an arrangement in which a company pays your costs if you get ill
exampleSentence: Do you have health insurance?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có bảo hiểm y tế không?
